text_overrides.ordinary_2: Not too bad. There's always something that needs stitching.
text_overrides.ordinary_3: Doing fairly well. A little tired, that's all.
text_overrides.content_2: Quite well. I like making something useful out of a bit of leather.
text_overrides.stressed_2: I've got a lot on my mind.
text_overrides.stressed_3: Worn down, honestly. I need a bit of a rest.
